verdict.rationale: On the API side, skills are referenced with a `skill_id` and an optional `version`, which allows explicit pinning. In Claude Code, plugins carry a manifest version and are described as supporting "versioned releases" and marketplace "version tracking", but the same docs also advertise "automatic updates", with nothing showing how a lead can pin or freeze what teammates receive. Missing for 10: a lockfile, a documented way to pin plugin/marketplace versions or turn off automatic updates in Claude Code, team-wide update gating, and any hands-on corroboration.
